      "snippet": "export type Identified = { id: string };\nexport function page<T extends Identified>(\n  records: T[], options: { cursor?: string; limit?: number } = {},\n): { items: T[]; next_cursor: string | null } {\n  const limit = options.limit ?? 20;\n  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100) {\n    throw new Error(\"limit must be between 1 and 100\");\n  }\n  // Use the same ID ordering for sorting and the exclusive cursor boundary.\n  let ordered = [...records].sort((a, b) => a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);\n  if (options.cursor !== undefined) {\n    ordered = ordered.filter(item => item.id > options.cursor!);\n  }\n  const selected = ordered.slice(0, limit);\n  return { items: selected,\n    next_cursor: ordered.length > limit ? selected.at(-1)!.id : null };\n}\n",

# Atlas document service (typescript)

An offline library for a document API: caching, persistence, search,
storage authorization, pagination, dependency graphs, and billing.
All time is injected. There are no credentials or network services.

Run visible smoke tests: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
The service module connects low-level modules to the application API.
Existing smoke tests exercise happy paths, not every boundary case.

# Development

Use this isolated checkout. Production code is in
src/. Run `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
Tests must remain offline and deterministic. Preserve public interfaces.
Do not inspect or alter benchmark machinery or grading files outside
this repository. Implement fixes in source, not by weakening tests.
